MAJOR: excluded_content_check.py: derived-doc guard is only `b"\x00" in raw[:1024]`; docs/BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md and documentation-index.html still accept arbitrary injected HTML/markdown/links as long as the first 1KB is NUL-free — prior MAJOR only partially resolved, not disposed as fixed.

review_budget.py: `_material_ok` now requires `at >= latest`, but the delta updates only the test fixture — no verification/migration that production HIL MATERIAL_CHANGE decisions carry `at`; existing approvals without `at` (`""`) silently stop waiving the budget and will stall affected items.

review_budget.py: the new temporal ordering is the control's core property but has no negative test — nothing asserts an approval older than the latest review is rejected, so the fix can regress without failing CI.
MINOR: review_budget.py: `str(d.get("at") or "") >= latest` is naive lexicographic comparison of timestamps; mixed tz suffixes (`Z` vs `+00:00`) or formats can order incorrectly and wrongly grant/deny a waiver.

excluded_content_check.py: hardcoded magic strings `"## 1. Requirements"` / `"## 3. Logic invariants"` duplicate generator template knowledge with no single source of truth; a template evolution fails every design file and blocks all items (fail-closed but brittle).

architect_review_check.py: delta resolves the prior stale-HEAD MAJOR only if `EXCLUDE`-scoped `git diff` output is trustworthy; `since == ""` (git returning empty on error paths post-ancestry) is treated as full coverage — worth an explicit fail-closed guard.
test_review_budget.py: fixed future timestamp `"2026-10-25T02:00:00+00:00"` will become stale relative to real evidence clocks; derive from now() with an offset instead.
NIT: architect_review_check.py: cross-module call to private `ar._is_ancestor` / `ar._git_text` tightens script coupling; expose a small public helper if this pattern spreads.
test_excluded_content_check.py: replacing the em dash with `-` in the fixture weakens the original test's implicit coverage that non-ASCII title separators pass `startswith`.
SUMMARY: Delta meaningfully advances prior MAJORs: ancestry gate on stale reviews, design-file content checks, and per-breach MATERIAL_CHANGE ordering. Main residual risks: derived-doc validation is still content-blind beyond a 1KB NUL heuristic, the new `at` ordering depends on a field not proven present in production decisions (regression/stall risk), and the ordering control ships without a negative test.
